entries.1425abe64824db84: This is the company group's business of manufacturing and selling, in Japan and overseas, cooking appliances such as rice cookers and microwave ovens, living products such as stainless steel mugs, and household appliances such as humidifiers. The securities report states that the company group engages in 'manufacture and sale of household products and related incidental operations', and that because businesses other than household products are considered to be of minor importance, segment information is omitted. In the fiscal year ended November 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥91,151 million, of which Japan accounted for ¥61,446 million and overseas for ¥29,704 million (overseas revenue ratio 32.6%). No customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue. Revenue by product category can be read from the following four product categories. Manufacturing is handled in Japan by Zojirushi Factory Japan, and overseas by Xinxiang Zhizaochang Co., Ltd. (Hong Kong) and the affiliate Union Zojirushi (Thailand); sales are handled by the company and sales companies in Japan and overseas.

entries.1845131fe6db6fac: This segment covers cooking home appliances, such as rice cookers, microwave ovens, toaster ovens, electric kettles and electric pots. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥64,384 million (up 5.2% year on year), the largest of the four product segments, with ¥44,800 million from Japan and ¥19,583 million from overseas. The securities report states that in Japan, sales of the top-of-the-line pressure IH rice cooker 'Enbu-taki' were strong, and that the microwave oven 'EVERINO' also exceeded the prior year, contributing to this with an expanded product lineup. Overseas, rice cookers performed well in Taiwan and North America, while sales in China declined from the prior year, and overseas sales as a whole fell below the prior year's results. Manufacturing is handled by Zojirushi Factory Japan in Japan and by Shinshō Seizōshō Yūgen Kōshi overseas.

entries.299b5bf5fd3f19c3: The company, together with 11 subsidiaries and 3 affiliates, manufactures and sells household products and engages in related operations (from the annual securities report for the fiscal year ended November 2025). Manufacturing is handled in Japan by the subsidiary Zojirushi Factory Japan, and overseas by Xinxiang Manufacturing Plant Co., Ltd. (Hong Kong; a [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiary]] in which the company holds 51.0% of the voting rights) and the affiliate Union Zojirushi Co., Ltd. (Thailand; 49.0% held). Sales are handled in Japan by the company, Zojirushi Fresco and Zojirushi Tokuhan, and overseas by Zojirushi America Corporation (United States), Shanghai Zojirushi Household Electrical Appliances Co., Ltd. (China), Taixiang Co., Ltd. (Taiwan), Zojirushi SE Asia Corporation Ltd. (Thailand), Lin & Partners Distributors Limited (Hong Kong), Zojirushi Korea Corporation (South Korea), and the affiliate N&I ASIA PTE LTD. Logistics is handled by Zojirushi U-Service and the affiliate Asahiryo Warehouse, and product repair and recycling is handled by Zojirushi U-Service. The company acquired Lin & Partners in September 2025, and Zojirushi Korea, established on October 1, 2025, is scheduled to start operations in April 2026. As of November 20, 2025, consolidated employees numbered 1,515 (temporary employees averaged 1,230), and the head office is in Kita-ku, Osaka.
entries.29f49bb3af39005f: Household appliances: humidifiers, air purifiers, dish dryers
entries.30f2f7a55b3d4135: The company makes cooking appliances such as rice cookers, microwave ovens, oven toasters, electric kettles and electric pots; living products such as stainless steel soup jars and stainless steel mugs; and household appliances such as humidifiers, air purifiers and dish dryers. For its flagship pressure IH rice cooker “Enbu-taki” and microwave oven “EVERINO,” in the fiscal year ended November 2025 it developed the new “Enbu-taki” model NX-AA and the EVERINO ES-LA30 model, which features an industry-first “twin-engine structure,” and it also developed the stainless steel mug SU-BA model and the steam humidifier EE-FA50 model. R&D expenses were ¥994 million (cooking appliances ¥791 million, living products ¥136 million, household appliances ¥66 million). According to the annual securities report, production is in principle make-to-stock, and production results for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥57,388 million (expressed at manufacturing cost). The main raw materials are stainless steel, resin and copper, and their prices are stated to be strongly influenced by international market conditions.

entries.7b4a584a62d8683e: This segment centers on stainless steel insulated and cold-retention containers, such as stainless steel soup jars and stainless steel mugs. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥16,430 million (down 9.4% year on year), and it is the only one of the four product segments in which overseas revenue (¥8,490 million) exceeds domestic revenue (¥7,939 million). The securities report states that in Japan, stainless steel soup jars performed well, while sales of the core One-Touch Mug declined, and the segment as a whole fell below the prior year's results. Overseas as well, sales of stainless steel products were weak in China and South Korea, and results fell below the prior year. Manufacturing is handled by Zojirushi Factory Japan in Japan and by the affiliate Union Zojirushi Co., Ltd. (Thailand) overseas.
entries.7ec8ca302bf6fb65: This segment covers items that do not fall into the three product segments above. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥2,680 million (up 16.6% year on year), with ¥1,986 million from Japan and ¥693 million from overseas. The securities report attributes this revenue increase to strong performance in the food and beverage business, centered on Zojirushi Shokudo. The securities report does not specify what, besides the food and beverage business, is included in this segment.
entries.7ed6e57c2a4723d7: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥91,151 million, an increase of ¥3,929 million (4.5%) from the previous fiscal year. By breakdown, cooking appliances were ¥64,384 million (up 5.2% from the previous fiscal year), living products ¥16,430 million (down 9.4%), household appliances ¥7,656 million (up 36.7%) and other ¥2,680 million (up 16.6%; the securities report states that the food service business, centered on Zojirushi Shokudo, performed well), and cooking appliances account for about 7 tenths of revenue. Japan was ¥61,446 million (up 10.1%) and overseas was ¥29,704 million (down 5.4%), and the overseas revenue ratio was 32.6%. Overseas, sales in Taiwan were strong, but China declined substantially from the previous year. Revenue is the transaction price after deducting consideration paid to customers such as rebates, and is recorded when the product is delivered (for sales in Japan, at the time of shipment if the period from shipment to delivery is normal).

entries.955b47d654c86ba3: For the fiscal year ended November 2025, operating income was ¥7,436 million (up 24.9% year on year; operating margin 8.2%), ordinary income was ¥8,300 million (up 12.1%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥5,980 million (down 7.5%). The annual securities report explains that operating income rose because, although selling, general and administrative expenses increased, sales of high-priced products in Japan were strong and the company passed on to prices the higher import costs caused by the weaker yen. The decline in net income was because the previous year included a gain on sale of fixed assets from the transfer of land and buildings associated with the relocation of a logistics warehouse, recorded as an extraordinary gain. The 2025 targets of the previous medium-term management plan, “SHIFT” (consolidated revenue ¥90,000 million, consolidated operating income ¥7,200 million), were both exceeded. The next medium-term management plan, “BEYOND,” aims for consolidated revenue of ¥100,000 million and consolidated operating income of ¥9,000 million in the fiscal year ending November 2028.

entries.ddf76ce35df68ca0: In Japan the company sells directly, and the domestic sales companies Zojirushi Fresco and Zojirushi Tokuhan also handle sales. Overseas, it sells through sales companies and others in the United States, China, Taiwan, Thailand, Hong Kong and South Korea. The securities report states that it adapted to the shift of overseas markets to EC and strengthened its direct-trade sales structure by establishing a South Korea branch in 2023. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025, by customer location, was ¥61,446 million in Japan, ¥16,898 million in Asia (of which ¥5,426 million in China), ¥11,755 million in North, Central and South America and ¥1,051 million in other regions. There is no customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue. It pays customers rebates (sales rebates) aimed at promoting product sales, and the unpaid amount of ¥1,995 million at the end of the fiscal year ended November 2025 is recorded as a refund liability. The auditor's report in the securities report lists the completeness and accuracy of this refund liability as a key audit matter (a matter the auditor judged to be of particular importance in the audit). Shipments concentrate from early autumn to early spring and tend to be weighted toward the first quarter.
